definitions.alignment: Primary: centre, O(2) rotation/reflection, match shipped RMS radius on the hub set; control: least-squares similarity scale, permitting shrinkage.
definitions.cluster_null: Permute fitted labels at fixed cluster sizes; k/partition are NOT reoptimised.
definitions.commute: m(x,y)+m(y,x) on that same hub chain, chain steps (= plies under symmetric initiative, which has no 0-ply cells); no square root.
definitions.diameter: Maximum Euclidean separation among ALL shipped layout nodes, including techniques.
definitions.diffusion: Exact directed D_t on the mu-weighted hub lump of the standing-reachable Q-process (the roll conditioned never to finish), t in {1,2,4} chain steps.
definitions.displacement_null: Permute each alternative's coordinates then refit the SAME alignment.
definitions.exit_hellinger: sqrt(sum((sqrt(p)-sqrt(q))^2)/2); H^2 <= TV <= H sqrt(2-H^2) <= sqrt(2) H.
definitions.exit_js: sqrt((KL_2(p||m)+KL_2(q||m))/2), m=(p+q)/2 (JS divergence in bits); J^2 <= TV <= sqrt(2 ln 2) J.
definitions.exit_law: E = [K.exit_law() | draw]: P(the roll ends by (finishing technique, who), or a draw). Hub law: group finishers by raw `type` (or by technique), relabel who -> the player's STARTING seat at the hub, average both seats and a fair starting-turn coin.
definitions.exit_tv: TV = sum|p-q|/2 on the hub law. Proposition 1: = the largest difference two hubs give to ANY event about the ending measurable in these columns.
definitions.exit_tv_clocked: TV on the type-grouped law of the CLOCKED roll (maxMoves uniform on 9..12 plies) with DRAW and CLOCK columns.
definitions.exit_tv_technique: TV on the (starting seat x finishing technique) + draw law: the finest grouping.
definitions.hops: Undirected unweighted shortest path over every shipped layout node/link (the layout's own input graph), restricted to comparison hubs only after BFS.
definitions.hull_purity: Fraction of hubs whose nearest shipped ground-coordinate neighbour shares the fitted exit-law cluster; a locality proxy, not convex-hull containment.
definitions.null: Seeded uniform permutations of hub coordinates (or, for target concordance, of one matrix's hub labels); same estimator as observed.
definitions.permutation_p: (1 + nulls at least as extreme)/(replicates+1); exploratory, unadjusted.
definitions.robustness: Ruling 1: a per-hub claim carries the share of K.perturbed(0.2,0.2,seed 0..199) in which it holds, and whether it holds under the other initiative, the other frame and origin=False.
definitions.scope: Hub-only alternative coordinates; no layout change is applied; technique relayout not priced.
definitions.shipped_screen: Shipped ground points through _deriveDualPairs' isometric projection, before its 0.1 rounding, the pair lift and de-overlap.

dual_pair_invariants: rep top/attacker remains the hub ID and ordinal
one ground point per hub, shared isometric projection
no new role or technique Markov states and no extra pair transition
game: the corpus's game: both seats sample authored attempt shares (not the app's opponent policy)

randomness.streams: SHA256-named SeedSequence substreams; PAM seed=3102+k; K.perturbed seeds 0..replicates-1

robustness.set_definition: 122 positive-mass hubs of the primary; K.perturbed(eps, eps, seed) for seed 0..199; clusters refit at the baseline-selected k

screen_projection.set_definition: all 133 shipped position hubs, ground plane vs the _deriveDualPairs isometric projection (before 0.1 rounding and de-overlap)

all.set_definition: all joined shipped technique hubs in this category; canonical origin; all position hubs, including origin, in uniform null
